Rina (CSM): NovaWave dedicated bring-up Friday 08:30 PT. Target steady 600 RPS, short bursts to 2k. Need final signoff on quotas, autoscale policy, and the enablement doc. Renewal flagged — want a clean run.

Diego (SRE): Got it. Contract lists 10 reserved GPUs, +20% burst if spare. I'll apply a 24h slot lock post-cutover. Please share token distribution.

Nora (Infra): Sample says p50=60, p95=205, avg ~300 tokens. Recommend max_seq=512, min_slots=4, scale_step=2, cooldown=90s. Add fallback to quantized-lean model on latency >600ms x3 windows.

Sam (Solutions): Load plan: smoke 10m @100RPS, soak 2h @600RPS, and burst script: ramp 30s -> 2k, hold 30s. I'll run loadgen and upload traces.

Rina (CSM): I'll invite customer SREs and billing. Action items: Nora pre-warm KV cache today EOD; Diego set soft-throttle AM; Sam run the scripts during window. ops-bot, set reminder.

ops-bot: scheduled: "NovaWave dedicated warmup" on 2024-03-22T15:30:00Z (Fri 08:30 PT). Post-run summary will be posted here. :rocket:
